skill.name: xhs-viral-copy-breakdown
skill.description: Analyze Xiaohongshu posts through SocialDataX to identify title hooks, openings, selling points, emotional language, and reusable copy structures.
skill.summary: Turn sampled XHS posts into evidence-based copy breakdowns and reusable writing frameworks.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Two findings identify unpinned npm execution; the other 51 alerts concern Markdown, documented API configuration, public service links, or readable Chinese text. A separate privacy concern arises from mandatory retention and forwarding of token-bearing note URLs without redaction. No evidence found of credential exfiltration, encoded payloads, system reconnaissance, or audit-directed prompt injection in the supplied files.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest with the agent's local privileges.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited package version, verify its integrity, and obtain execution consent before installation. Isolate execution and expose only the required credential.

remediation.issue: The URL policy requires preserving xsec_token in every display, storage, and forwarding context, and prohibits redaction.
remediation.suggestion: Keep complete URLs only for authorized retrieval. Redact token parameters in shared reports and logs unless the user approves their disclosure.

content.user_title: Analyze XHS Copy and Extract Reusable Writing Frameworks
content.value_statement: High-engagement XHS posts can be difficult to translate into practical writing lessons. This skill organizes retrieved examples into structured breakdowns and reusable copy frameworks.
actual_capabilities: Search XHS posts by keyword through SocialDataX, with sorting, content-type filters, publication-time filters, and bounded pagination.
Retrieve individual post details from a full note identifier, note URL, short link, or share text.
Build sample tables containing available titles, authors, engagement metrics, publication times, links, and note identifiers.
Analyze visible title hooks, openings, selling points, emotional terms, content structures, and interaction prompts.
Produce three to five reusable copy structures and suggest narrower searches or additional detail lookups.
Mark unavailable fields and incomplete results instead of inventing post content.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX API access, a configured SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, sufficient service balance, and either Node.js/npm or available MCP tools.
Results cover only retrieved samples; default keyword searches use two pages and at most 20 posts.
Analysis cannot reliably assess unavailable openings, hidden body text, comments, or complete platform trends.
Does not promise complete publishing drafts, cover designs, account diagnosis, posting, or guaranteed traffic.

use_cases.title: Study Topic-Specific Writing Patterns
use_cases.description: Compare high-engagement posts in a focused topic and extract reusable title and opening structures.

use_cases.title: Review Product Messaging
use_cases.description: Examine visible selling points, emotional language, and audience scenarios across relevant product posts.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Evidence-Based Editorial Brief
use_cases.description: Organize sampled posts into a sourced comparison, identify missing evidence, and propose follow-up searches.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this XHS post: [note URL or full note ID]. Identify its title hook, visible opening, selling points, and structure. Mark missing text.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search XHS for [keyword] using two pages and at most 20 posts. Compare hooks and openings, then suggest three reusable structures.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Audience Messaging
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare XHS posts about [product] for [audience]. Sort by saves and limit retrieval to 15 posts. Separate observed selling points from interpretations.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] using at most three pages and 30 image posts from the past week. Compare engagement signals and produce five frameworks. Document gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine filters, evidence review, and framework synthesis

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied title: Three lunch ideas for busy office workers. No body text or metrics supplied.
output: Title hook: a numbered list combines a practical benefit with a specific audience.
Opening and structure: unavailable because the body text was not supplied.
Next step: retrieve the post details before assessing its opening or engagement.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied title: I stopped buying five cleaning products. Supplied opening: My small apartment needed less clutter.
output: Title hook: a personal change and a concrete number create curiosity.
Opening: the small-apartment scenario connects the claim to a visible constraint.
Selling point: reduced clutter is explicit; savings and performance are not established.
Reusable framework: I changed [habit] because [specific constraint].
Missing evidence: full body text, author, publication time, and engagement metrics.

best_practices: Start with a focused keyword or full note identifier, and set explicit page and item limits.
Separate visible evidence from interpretation, and mark unavailable text or incomplete retrieval.
Review package execution before granting access, and approve any disclosure of token-bearing links in shared reports.
anti_patterns: Treating a small, engagement-sorted sample as complete platform coverage or proof of causal success.
Inventing missing openings, metrics, comments, or body text to complete the report.
Executing unreviewed package updates or forwarding token-bearing URLs without considering access and privacy.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword, niche, audience, product direction, note URL, share text, or complete note identifier.

faq.question: What setup does retrieval require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient SocialDataX balance. Use Node.js/npm for the CLI, or use the corresponding available MCP tools.

faq.question: How many posts are searched by default?
faq.answer: Keyword searches default to two pages and at most 20 high-engagement samples. Filters and retrieval limits affect coverage.

faq.question: Does it read comments or modify my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow analyzes visible post content without reading comments, logging in, posting, liking, or modifying accounts.

faq.question: Can it guarantee a viral post?
faq.answer: No. It extracts patterns from retrieved examples and suggests frameworks, but does not guarantee traffic or a complete publishing draft.

faq.question: What happens when retrieval fails?
faq.answer: Non-balance errors allow one retry after checks. Balance errors stop retries; partial results remain marked incomplete and resume only with valid pagination.
